type: Analytic conservative finite-record bounds and deterministic synthetic verification

estimand.name: Q_T(t)
estimand.unit: One fixed roster of baseline cells; equal selected-family weights
estimand.p: Probability a future-blind uniformly chosen daughter path is alive at t in the completed family
estimand.f: Indicator that any descendant of that baseline cell is alive at T

scope: Finite recorded-roster path-probability average, not a population expectation or clinical endpoint
row_mass_rules: At a verified division split chronological mass equally between the two daughters.
An absent daughter contributes unresolved mass, not zero survival.
Unknown subtrees form a disjoint frontier; do not double-count an unknown ancestor and a known descendant.
Lower bound is verified-live mass; upper bound adds all unresolved mass once.
Tracking after apoptosis is not living mass; event timing and observation contradictions require explicit uncertainty.
Any verified living descendant establishes family inclusion; extinction requires all possible paths verified extinct.

compatibility.all_t_le_T: For finite nonexplosive binary trees, f(T)=1 implies p(t)>0. An upper bound of zero excludes selection; a known selected family with upper=0 is inconsistent.
compatibility.earlier_t: f(T)=0 does not imply p(t)=0 for t<T.
compatibility.endpoint: At t=T, p(T)>0 iff f(T)=1. Known exclusion forces p=0; positive lower bound forces inclusion; zero upper bound forces exclusion.
compatibility.strict_boundary: Selected rows with lower=0 use a closure infimum. Zero need not be attained by any selected completed tree; arbitrarily large unknown division depth can make positive mass arbitrarily small.

marginal_envelope.lower: min_k (A + sum of k smallest optional lower bounds)/(n+k)
marginal_envelope.upper: max_k (B + sum of k largest optional upper bounds)/(n+k)
marginal_envelope.claim: Exact infimum/supremum in the closed rectangular interval/selection relaxation; conservative outer bounds for true compatible tree completions.
marginal_envelope.denominator: If n=m=0, Q is undefined. If n=0,m>0, report that zero selection is not excluded by marginal information, and bounds apply only to positive-denominator completions.
marginal_envelope.baseline_control: For verified living baseline cells p_i(0)=1, hence Q(0)=1 whenever defined.

contrast_envelope.definition: Delta=Q_T2(t)-Q_T1(t), T2>T1>=t; same roster and same p_i(t)
contrast_envelope.logical_nesting: f_i(T2)<=f_i(T1); later known inclusion implies earlier inclusion, and earlier known extinction implies later extinction.
contrast_envelope.fixed_count_identity: Delta=(1-N2/N1)*(Q_later-Q_early_only) if N1>N2; Delta=0 if N1=N2.
contrast_envelope.count_only_cap: With a=max(1,|K2|), b=|K1|+|O1|, intersect subtraction with [-(1-a/b), +(1-a/b)]. Require positive later selection and consistent b>=a>=1.
contrast_envelope.attainability: Nonsharp in general; separate extrema can require incompatible common probabilities or tree completions.

future_joint_relaxation.constraints: Known status permissions and capacities N-N1, N1-N2, N2; consistency reductions applied first.
future_joint_relaxation.method: Count-conditioned dynamic programming or minimum-cost assignment, then optimize across feasible counts.
future_joint_relaxation.claim_limit: Exact for the common-p interval/nested-selection relaxation, not automatically sharp for actual full trees.

interpretation: No stochastic confidence level is attached to these missing-information bounds.
Excluding zero establishes a finite-record descriptive contrast under the assumptions, not rejection of population horizon invariance without sampling and observation modeling.
Including zero means this outer envelope has not excluded equality; it does not prove fundamental nonidentifiability or failure of all tighter methods.
Unknown original-cohort coverage and selection prevent extending these bounds to that population without added assumptions.
Related baseline cells and repeated path draws do not create independent experimental replicates.

verification.scope: Closed rectangular relaxation and nesting containment, not biological completion sharpness
